a_motion: Smooth camera pull-back and tilt-up with organic easing.
Subtle floating micro-animation on the central 'Live Now' pill.
Soft, shifting shadows on the grid floor reflecting camera movement.
b_motion: Linear, mechanical zoom-out with stiff easing.
Static 'Live Now' button lacking organic hover drift.
Flat, static shadows with no realistic perspective shift.
absent_in_b: Warm light bloom on the white tile surfaces.
Soft ambient occlusion in the tile crevices.

differences.a_does: Executes a dynamic pull-back with organic ease-out and subtle rotation.
differences.b_does: Uses a rigid, linear zoom-out with stiff interpolation.
differences.fix: Adjust camera curve tangents to ease-out smoothly over 30 frames and add 1.5 degrees of roll.

differences.a_does: Features soft, diffused global illumination with realistic contact shadows.
differences.b_does: Has flat, sterile lighting with harsh, uniform shadows.
differences.fix: Increase light source radius by 50% and enable indirect diffuse bounce.

differences.a_does: Applies a subtle matte texture with fine roughness to the tiles.
differences.b_does: Uses perfectly smooth, default plastic shaders.
differences.fix: Add a subtle noise map to the roughness channel (roughness 0.5) to break up specular highlights.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Re-animate the camera pull-back using cubic bezier curves to match the elegant ease-out of the reference.

a_motion: Camera slowly zooms out and pans up, revealing the grid layout.

Static lighting with no dynamic shadow or reflection shifts.

differences.b_does: Spaces the cards too far apart, leaving excessive empty white background.

differences.a_does: Features soft, diffused shadows and realistic ambient occlusion under the card edges.
differences.b_does: Has flat, uniform lighting with almost no contact shadows or ambient occlusion.

differences.a_does: Displays a rich, warm golden-yellow for the Recurly card and a deep royal blue for the Juspay card.
differences.b_does: Displays a colder, slightly greenish-yellow and a flatter blue.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Enable a shallow depth of field on the camera to match the professional cinematic focus of the reference.
